title: R3 carrier and yoke - maintenance arrangement register

sections.heading: Document control
sections.text: Status: current for the incident configuration. Equipment identifiers CB-3/YK-3. Backup rolls removed; carrier initially raised and seated on the yoke.

sections.heading: Arrangement
sections.text: The backup-roll-associated stop is absent in this configuration. No separate travel stop is fitted to prevent the raised carrier from reaching mill post/spreader interference. One keeper plate is fitted.

sections.heading: Retention limits
sections.text: The current record specifies 30 mm primary vertical seating engagement from the defined initial seat. Centered, seated keeper overlap is 8 mm. No approved off-center dynamic keeper-envelope calculation is contained in this revision.

sections.heading: Interpretation
sections.text: An intact installed keeper is not evidence that overlap is maintained at every lateral position. The absence of an envelope calculation describes a knowledge boundary; it does not itself cause physical motion.
